title: Peel a baking cup off a muffin
instruction: Peel the silicone baking cup off the muffin without breaking it. Leave the muffin and cup separate on the tray.
setup: One cooled plain muffin (68–76 mm across, 58–68 mm high, 40–50 g; nominal simulation 72 × 64 mm, 45 g) baked inside a flexible silicone cup: 60 mm rim, 52 mm base, 38 mm wall, two 16 × 24 × 1.5 mm pull tabs. It sits centrally on a fixed 320 × 280 × 4 mm stainless-steel tray between the arms. The cup is ungreased and has not been loosened. Both hands start open with clean, close-fitting food-safe removable pad covers. Use the recipe and batch checks in README.
scoring: 1.0 if the cup is fully off and the intact muffin and cup rest on the tray with their centres at least 75 mm apart for 3 seconds after both hands release. 0.5 if adhesion has released around at least three quarters of the cup wall; 0.25 for at least half; otherwise 0. A torn cup, split muffin or detached piece larger than 5 mm scores 0. Judge the released circumference from close views and gentle inspection; use a ruler for separation.
fidelity: Native robot contacts manipulate a cohesive muffin and a flexible cup made of passive jointed panels. Force-limited adhesion resists peeling; cup seams and muffin-cap bonds can break. The demo grips the tab on the tray before peeling while supporting the muffin. Silicone bending, crumb strength and adhesion are coarse uncalibrated approximations. There are no hand attachments, commanded prop poses or success-triggered releases.
context: Removing a reusable baking cup requires peeling the flexible cup while supporting a fragile muffin.
reset_notes: Prepare a batch ahead using the README plain-muffin recipe: 52 ± 1 g batter per clean, dry, ungreased cup; bake at 220 °C conventional for 15–20 minutes, then cool in the cup to 18–22 °C. Accept only 40–50 g muffins within the stated size range, still adhered and undamaged. Keep them in their cups; use within 2–4 hours of baking. Swap in a fresh accepted muffin/cup each trial. Wash and dry the tray and food-safe removable covers between trials.
